parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, I'm interested in applying for the flight attendant position that was advertised. Could you provide me with information about the application process?

Certainly. To apply, you'll need to email your CV and a cover letter to Sarah Meehan. I spell her family name for you. M, double e, h, a, n. She's responsible for selecting and hiring candidates.

What is her job title?

She is a senior manager in the recruitment department.

Thank you for letting me know. Can you tell me more about the job itself? What are the main responsibilities?

Sure. While the new opening doesn't involve frequent long-distance flights, there may be occasional overnight flights. This means you'll need to work night shifts. As a flight attendant, your main responsibilities will include providing excellent customer service, ensuring passenger safety and assisting with any in-flight needs.

I see. Are there any specific qualifications or skills required for this position?

Yes. Proficiency in English is essential. Since we have passengers from all over the world, you'll need to be able to communicate effectively in this international language. Additionally, you should be adept at Math, so you can handle tasks that require calculations such as passenger count.

I studied relevant subjects at university, so I should be able to meet those requirements. By the way, are there any physical requirements?

Yes. Candidates should be able to swim and have good vision, including the ability to differentiate between colors. Visual inspections of the aircraft, such as checking for damage or irregularities, monitoring cabin conditions, and ensuring proper functioning of safety equipment are part of the job.

That makes sense. I have previous experience working in a cafe. Will that give me a competitive advantage?

Absolutely. Previous experience in customer service can be a valuable asset. Providing customers with different forms of assistance demonstrates your communication skills, and understanding of important service sector values, such as patience and empathy.

I was also involved in daily food preparation in this job.

They will definitely appreciate that. It shows that you have relevant skills and can handle the job’s demands.

Is there anything else I should keep in mind?

Yes. Demonstrating cultural awareness is also important. Our airline values diversity and wants flight attendants who can interact effectively with passengers from different backgrounds, being familiar with their customs and values.

That’s good to know. When is the application deadline? I need to prepare my documents accordingly.

It’s October 29th. We have several attendants retiring on November 6th, so we’re looking to fill the positions as soon as possible.

Okay. I’ll make sure to submit my application before the deadline. Lastly, is there a probationary period for this position?

Yes. The probationary period is six months. During this time, your performance and suitability for the role will be assessed. It’s longer than the probationary period I had when I joined this company. We only had three months to showcase our skills and capabilities.

Thank you so much for providing all this information. I’ll make sure to submit my application soon.

analyses.content: 录音中在提到人名 Sarah Meehan 后，紧接着给出了拼写 M, double e, h, a, n，直接按字母拼写即可。
To apply, you'll need to email your CV and a cover letter to Sarah Meehan. I spell her family name for you. M, double e, h, a, n.
听到 double e 时要反应过来是两个 e，不要只写一个，也不要漏掉最后的 n。
She is a senior manager in the recruitment department.
不要填 senior manager（高级经理），那是她的职位（Job Title），而不是部门名称。
题干问的是地点（Place/Department），录音中回答她在 recruitment department（招聘部门）担任高级经理。
While the new opening doesn't involve frequent long-distance flights, there may be occasional overnight flights. This means you'll need to work night shifts.
虽然前面提到了 overnight（隔夜），但它修饰的是 flights，修饰 shifts 的词是 night。
录音提到偶尔会有隔夜航班，这意味着你需要工作 night shifts（夜班），对应题干 cover ... shifts。
Additionally, you should be adept at Math, so you can handle tasks that require calculations such as passenger count.
不要填 calculations（计算），那是你需要处理的任务（tasks that require...），而不是你需要具备的学科能力。
录音说你应该 adept at（擅长）Math（数学），以便处理计算任务，对应题干 Good at ...。
Candidates should be able to swim and have good vision, including the ability to differentiate between colors.
不要填 swim，虽然这也是要求，但原文结构是 be able to swim，而 have good... 只能搭配名词 vision。
题干要求填一种身体素质（Have good...），录音中直接提到候选人应该 have good vision（视力好）。
进入工作经验部分，申请人提到在咖啡馆工作的经验，说提供 customers（顾客）协助能展示沟通技巧，对应题干 Helping...。
Providing customers with different forms of assistance demonstrates your communication skills...
虽然这篇对话的主题是空乘，前面多次提到 passengers，但在描述之前的咖啡馆工作经验时，对象是 customers。
I was also involved in daily food preparation in this job.
注意不要只填 preparation，那是动作（Preparing 的名词形式），题干缺的是宾语（准备什么东西）。
申请人补充说自己还参与了日常的 food preparation（食物准备），对应题干 Preparing...。
Demonstrating cultural awareness is also important. Our airline values diversity...
不要填 diversity（多样性），那是航空公司重视的价值观（Our airline values diversity），不是申请者需要展示的个人特质。
录音提到 Demonstrating cultural awareness（展示文化意识）也很重要，对应题干 show ...（show = demonstrate）。
It’s October 29th. We have several attendants retiring on November 6th...
小心干扰项 November 6th，那是员工退休（retiring）的日子，不是申请截止日期。
问到截止日期时，回答非常直接：It’s October 29th。
The probationary period is six months. ... It’s longer than the probationary period I had when I joined this company. We only had three months to showcase our skills and capabilities.
千万别填 three months，那是说话人当年入职时的旧规定（We only had three months...），用来做今昔对比的干扰项。
关于试用期，现任员工明确说 The probationary period is six months（试用期是六个月）。
